Appendix A points to external supplementary data, including the separately cited Table S2; these are not in the 14-page PDF and could not be inspected because both DOI and ScienceDirect requests were blocked by the environment.

summary: The reported assignment counts and creativity-analysis degrees of freedom support 95 analyzed people: AI 31, human 34, and control 30, so criterion 2 holds. No count discrepancy or reported creativity-analysis attrition was found; cross-paper overlap is not stated, and the external supplement could not be checked.
